Who We Are
We are a well-funded, early-stage technology company on a mission to fundamentally redefine the way the world searches, discovers, and transacts, built on a philosophy that puts the user first at every step.
The user is not simply a means of transaction. They are a valued participant whose data works for them, not against them, enriching their world and their own experience within it, with them retaining full control.
Our mission is underpinned by proprietary, patent-pending technology built on a novel engine and system.

The Problem You Will Be Solving
The internet was built to inform the many, not to serve the individual. Platforms optimize for engagement, extraction, and consumption at global scale. AI has made this model even more efficient, with the user still largely remaining the input, not the full beneficiary.
The problem is not information. The world has never had more. The problem is that people give away a lifetime of data without receiving the personalized experience it should enable.
People should not have to search. They should simply find.

Who You Are
• Highly talented and motivated to build products with people, for people
• You thrive in zero-to-one environments and find genuine satisfaction in creating from scratch
• A fast-paced thinker with a relentless desire to learn, improve, and raise the standard around you
• Able to inspire, elevate, and collaborate; you make the people around you better
• A great communicator; you express complex ideas with clarity, precision, and confidence across all levels of the organization
• Able to transform ideas into working systems and technical milestones with light speed and precision
• Highly ambitious and action-driven; you thrive under pressure and find genuine energy in working at the edge of what is considered possible

What You Will Do
• Design and build the core API platform and integration framework with strong versioning, consistency, and deep awareness of production consumer dependencies
• Build extensible third-party integration frameworks that connect external services across multiple domains through clean, unified interfaces
• Design and build unified identity and profile systems that deliver consistent, real-time user state across the platform
• Build high-reliability event streaming infrastructure as the backbone for real-time data flows, with strong guarantees around ordering, consumer management, and failure recovery
• Implement authentication and authorization infrastructure including OAuth 2.0, OIDC, fine-grained permissions, and secure multi-tenant access control suitable for consumer platforms with enterprise customers
• Build enterprise integration layers with secure API surfaces and data exchange protocols that allow institutional customers to reliably embed platform capabilities into their own systems

Minimum Qualifications
• MSc in Computer Science or Software Engineering from KTH, Chalmers, or an institution of equivalent standing
• Demonstrated experience originating distributed system architectures; you have designed systems, not implemented designs made by others
• Production experience building APIs that multiple consumers depend on; with experience managing the operational consequences of that dependency
• Deep understanding of event-driven architecture and the consistency trade-offs inherent in distributed data synchronization

Preferred Qualifications
• Background from Klarna, Tink, Trustly, Bambuser, or comparable platform-focused companies in the Stockholm ecosystem
• Experience with identity federation and secure multi-tenant system design at scale
• A track record of designing platform systems that other engineering teams depend on in production without requiring significant architectural revision
• Demonstrated track record of delivering reliable platform infrastructure faster than peers scope it
• 3–8 years of relevant experience

What We Offer
Expect the most talented, rigorous, and driven colleagues you have worked with; people who lift each other up and hold each other to the highest standard. This company is driven by ideas and innovation, regardless of age, position, or background. The best ideas must win and the people behind them recognized and rewarded.
A home for exceptional people and geniuses within their domain; those who have always known what they are capable of and have been waiting for the environment to prove it to the world, whilst first being seen and supported by their coworkers.
Compensation includes an attractive salary and meaningful equity ownership for an early-stage startup.

Equal Opportunity
We are an equal opportunity employer committed to building an inclusive, high-performance culture where everyone can do their best work and reach their full potential. We welcome applicants of all backgrounds and do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Application
To apply, send your CV/resume, LinkedIn profile, and a brief note on how and why you would like to contribute to our mission. Upon initial acceptance, an online interview will follow shortly in Stockholm, Sweden.
Please note that all applications and interviews are conducted in English. Fluency in written and spoken English is a requirement for all roles.
All applications are treated with strict confidentiality.

jobs.occupation: PhD student in biomass resources from sustainable cropping systems
jobs.description:
Department of Biosystems and Technology
 
PhD project in Agricultural Science: Using agricultural crop biomass for biogas in synergy with the development of sustainable cropping systems
 
Note: This advertisement is abbreviated to fit in Platsbanken's recruitment tool. To view the ad in its entirety including additional information, please visit https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/work-at-slu/jobs-and-vacancies/
 
About the position
Targeting the sustainable supply of agricultural crop biomass as substrates for biogas, the project will use a field experiment platform to investigate crop yields and crop nutrient dynamics in different scenarios for biomass removal and nutrient redistribution via digestates. The research will primarily be based on an ongoing long-term cropping systems experiment with four distinct systems: conventional, organic, agroforestry and perennial cereal.
The biomass resources to be studied include, but are not limited to: cover crops, ley, straw (from cereals, grain legumes and oilseed crops), beet leaves, and possibly wood. Studies on quantities and nutrient contents of different biomasses build on existing data from the experiment, to be complemented with additional sample collection and analyses as well as literature data or data from agricultural statistics databases.
 
The holder of this position will be a part of a national transdisciplinary center of excellence called Biogas Solutions Research Center (BSRC). Here, co-production of new and relevant knowledge is generated through collaboration between different scientific disciplines as well as between researchers and practitioners from industry and public organizations. The BSRC includes researchers and support from two universities, Linköping University and Swedish University of Agricultural Sciences, as well as about 50 private and public organizations involving all parts of the biogas system. It also has support from the Swedish Energy Agency.
 
All doctoral positions advertised within BSRC will be formulated so that they fit into the competence center's research plans and at the same time reflect our parties' interests. This way, we ensure long-term competence supply to both industry and academia.
 
Requirements
To meet the general entry requirements you must have been awarded a second-cycle (Master’s) qualification, satisfied the requirements for courses comprising at least 240 credits of which at least 60 credits were awarded in the second-cycle, or acquired substantially equivalent knowledge in some other way in Sweden or abroad (Higher Education Ordinance 1993:100, Chapter 7, Section 39).
 
You must also meet the equivalent English language requirements as those necessary for the Swedish upper-secondary qualification Engelska B/6.
 
You should have a Master’s degree, or equivalent qualification, in a relevant field such as agricultural engineering (with specialization in crop production), agricultural science, agroecology, agronomy, biology, environmental science, horticultural science or another closely related discipline.
 
Your profile
We are looking for a highly motivated candidate with an interest in sustainable agriculture and bioeconomy systems, and in analysing complex interactions between biomass and food production and cropping system sustainability.
 
Experience or documented knowledge in one or several of the following areas is particularly relevant:
agricultural cropping systems, crop management and diversification;
systems analysis and/or multi-criteria sustainability assessments;
modelling or scenario analysis;
bioenergy systems based on agricultural crop biomass resources;
nutrient cycling e.g. via redistribution of biomass resources and biogas digestates;
crop and soil nutrient dynamics and nutrient balances at field and cropping system levels;
statistical analysis and handling of datasets with multiple experimental factors and response variables

 
The project strives to provide knowledge for several societal sectors (bioenergy, food production, environmental impact), it is therefore important to have an ability to understand and integrate information from different scientific fields. The successful candidate should have good analytical skills, be able to work independently and systematically, and at the same time enjoy collaboration in an interdisciplinary research environment.
 
Excellent written and spoken English is required. Good communication skills and an interest in communicating research both scientifically and to stakeholders are important. Knowledge of Swedish is advantageous but not a requirement.
 
Personal qualities, motivation for doctoral studies and the ability to successfully complete the research project will be given considerable weight in the selection process.
 
About us
Information about the department: https://www.slu.se/en/about-slu/organisation/departments/biosystems-technology/
 
Read more about staff benefits and life as an SLU employee on https://www.slu.se/om-slu/jobba-pa-slu/
 
Read more about third-cycle courses and study programmes on http://www.slu.se/utbildning/program-kurser/forskarutbildning/
 
Form of employment / Funding
Employment as a doctoral student (4-year programme).
 
Doctoral student’s salaries are set following the local collective agreement. Salary progression is fixed.
 
Location:
Alnarp, Sweden
 
Scope:
100%
 
Start date:
Upon agreement. Preferably in January/February 2027.
 
Application and selection:
Please submit your application using the link below. The deadline is November 27, 2026. Applications cannot be submitted through the recruitment system on 20–22 November due to a system update.
 
Read more about the attachments that your application should include at https://www.slu.se/en/study/programmes-courses/doctoral-education/how-can-i-become-a-doctoral-student/application/
 
Selection among eligible applicants is based on the documents attached to the application, and is carried out with regard to the applicant’s ability to complete the programme within the allotted time.

jobs.occupation: Senior lecturer in dairy cow management
Product Data & 3D Configuration Consultant (Junior to Mid-Level)
jobs.description:
We’re looking for a junior to mid-level consultant to maintain product information and configure how products behave in 3D planning tools used by customers and staff across a range of customer interactions.
You’ll use a web-based product management system to add new products and update existing records. You’ll also define rules that govern how products behave in a 3D layout and how they interact with one another. Some configurations involve complex rules, and you’ll decide how to structure them so the tools handle each product as intended.
You’ll help plan the team’s day-to-day work and coordinate with colleagues across teams. This includes working with the people responsible for the product range and the 3D platform to clarify requirements and agree on how product rules should work.
What you’ll bring

Clear communication skills, particularly in English

An analytical approach to solving problems

A structured way of organising your work

The ability to learn new tools, processes and tasks quickly

A collaborative approach to working with others

Experience in a similar retail environment or familiarity with the types of products in the range is an advantage. A background in software development can help you get up to speed and is optional. We also value curiosity, an interest in making development work more efficient and a willingness to build new skills as tools and practices evolve.

We are seeking a Mechanical/Electrical Design Engineer with expertise in CAD design, simulation, and compliance to join our team at ALTEN Sweden in Örebro. In this role, you will work closely with multidisciplinary teams to develop, test, and optimize mechanical and electrical systems for clients in industries such as manufacturing, engineering, and life sciences.
WHAT DO WE OFFER?
As a consultant at ALTEN, you'll have the opportunity to work on challenging and exciting projects with some of our key clients, with:
Technical challenges and development opportunities.
An inspiring community and the chance to contribute to a sustainable future.
Supportive and coaching leadership.
The possibility to work across various industries where our clients operate.
A personal training budget for internal or external courses.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Creating and refining mechanical and electrical designs using CAD tools (e.g., AutoCAD, Creo).
Performing schematic design and component selection for electrical systems.
Ensuring designs comply with international standards (e.g., IEC, IEEE, ISO) and regulatory requirements for safety and efficiency.
Running simulations (e.g., MATLAB, Teamcenter) to validate designs and improve performance.
Collaborating with cross-functional teams to manage projects from concept to completion.

Qualifications:
Bachelor’s or Master’s Degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, or related fields.
Fluent in English
Minimum 1 years of hands-on experience in electrical system design, testing, or troubleshooting.
Swedish is a strong advantage

ABOUT ALTEN
ALTEN is one of Europe’s largest technology and IT consulting companies, with over 57,000 employees across approximately 30 countries. Our engineers carry out complex and highly technical projects throughout the entire product development chain for leading companies in several industries including Automotive, Defense & Security, Energy, Industrial Equipment, Public Sector, and Life Sciences.
In Sweden, we are approximately 1,300 dedicated employees spread across 9 offices in cities ranging from Lund in the south to Skellefteå in the north.
For the fifth year in a row, ALTEN has been named one of Sweden’s most attractive employers by Karriärföretagen for five consecutive years — an award for companies offering unique career and development opportunities.
Welcome to read more about us at alten.se

We are looking for an Electrical Design Engineer with expertise in low-voltage systems design, testing, and troubleshooting to join ALTEN Sweden. In this role, you will focus on creating wiring diagrams, cable designs, and ensuring compliance with international and Swedish electrical standards. You will work closely with installation teams and clients in industries such as industrial automation, building electrical systems, and sustainable infrastructure.
WHAT DO WE OFFER?
As a consultant at ALTEN, you'll have the opportunity to work on challenging and exciting projects with some of our key clients, with:
Technical challenges and development opportunities.
An inspiring community and the chance to contribute to a sustainable future.
Supportive and coaching leadership.
The possibility to work across various industries where our clients operate.
A personal training budget for internal or external courses.

ABOUT THE ROLE
Design and develop detailed wiring diagrams for low-voltage systems (e.g., lighting, fire alarm, security, automation).
Perform cable calculations (cross-sectional area, insulation type, derating factors) using tools like ETAP or DIgSILENT.
Ensure all designs comply with IEC 60364, NEC (NFPA 70), SS 424, and ELSÄK-FS 2023:1 standards.
Select appropriate cable types (e.g., NYY, JY(St)Y, Cat6) and design cable routing, shielding, and grounding.
Collaborate with installation teams to verify diagram accuracy and cable suitability.
Optimize designs for sustainability (LEED/BREEAM certification is a plus).
